The EVP Finance will work closely with the Group CFO, CEO, Board, business-unit CEOs, investment leadership, and senior executives to strengthen financial performance, capital efficiency, profitability, governance, risk management, and long-term enterprise value. Key Responsibilities Lead enterprise-wide financial strategy, planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management. Provide executive oversight of financial performance across subsidiaries, business units, and investment platforms. Drive Group-wide FP&A, management reporting, financial modelling, and commercial finance. Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, margins, cash flow, ROE, ROIC, and return on capital. Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, reinsurance, underwriting performance, and profitability. Provide financial leadership for investment and asset management businesses, including portfolio reporting, valuation, investment income, performance analysis, and cost management. Lead strategic capital planning, capital allocation, solvency, liquidity, and balance-sheet optimization. Provide executive oversight of treasury, funding, cash management, and liquidity planning. Establish and strengthen Group-wide financial governance, internal controls, accounting policies, and risk-management frameworks. Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, insurance regulations, investment regulations, and statutory reporting requirements. Lead financial evaluation and due diligence for M&A, acquisitions, joint ventures, strategic investments, restructuring, and market expansion. Partner with the Investment, Actuarial, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Treasury, and Operations functions on major strategic and financial decisions. Drive enterprise-wide cost optimization, operational efficiency, and profitability improvement. Lead finance transformation, including ERP modernization, automation, AI/data analytics, dashboards, and digital finance initiatives. Maintain senior relationships with regulators, auditors, investors, lenders, rating agencies, and other financial stakeholders. Provide high-level financial advice to the CEO, Group CFO, Board, and Executive Committee. Build a strong succession pipeline and lead senior finance executives across the organization. Support the development and execution of the Group's long-term growth and value-creation strategy. Strategic KPIs Group revenue and earnings growth EBITDA / operating profit ROE, ROIC, and return on capital Capital adequacy and solvency Investment portfolio performance Insurance underwriting profitability Budget and forecast accuracy Cost-to-income and expense efficiency Liquidity and treasury performance Balance-sheet optimization Cost of capital M&A and strategic investment returns Regulatory and audit performance Finance transformation and automation Shareholder and enterprise value creation Candidate Profile 18–25+ years of progressive finance experience, preferably within insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, reinsurance, pensions, or diversified financial services. Extensive experience in enterprise-level, Group, regional, or multi-entity finance leadership. Previous experience as EVP Finance, Executive Vice President Finance, Group Finance Director, Group CFO, CFO, SVP Finance, Finance Director, Deputy Group CFO, or equivalent. Strong understanding of insurance finance, investment finance, capital management, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory requirements. Demonstrated experience managing complex organizations with multiple subsidiaries, business lines, and jurisdictions. Strong commercial understanding of investments, financial markets, capital allocation, and enterprise performance. Proven track record in M&A, capital raising, strategic investments, restructuring, or major transformation initiatives. Extensive experience engaging with Boards, CEOs, regulators, investors, auditors, and other senior stakeholders. Proven ability to lead large, geographically dispersed finance organizations. Education & Professional Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related discipline. Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred. Additional qualifications in insurance, investments, risk, actuarial science, or financial management are advantageous. Core Competencies Enterprise Finance Strategy | Group Financial Management | FP&A | Financial Reporting | Insurance Finance | Investment Finance | Capital Allocation | Treasury | Solvency | Balance-Sheet Management | M&A | Financial Modelling | Risk Management | Governance | Regulatory Compliance | Cost Optimization | Finance Transformation | Executive Leadership Leadership Characteristics Exceptional strategic and commercial judgment Strong executive presence Enterprise-wide perspective High integrity and governance orientation Strong analytical and decision-making capability Excellent Board and stakeholder communication Results-driven and financially disciplined Transformational and innovation-oriented Strong talent-development and succession-planning capability Comfortable operating in complex, regulated, multinational environments

review_candidates.title: Event Director
review_candidates.description: Reports to: CEO / General Manager / Portfolio Director, MMI Asia Pte Ltd Based in: We don’t really care where you connect to wifi. We care about your results. Singapore/Thailand/Vietnam/Philippines/Malaysia, with regular travel across Southeast Asia Leads: A cross-functional show team – sales, marketing, operations, buyer acquisition, and content An entire industry has a place to meet three days a year. You're the reason it's worth their time. But you don't run an event. You run a marketplace where buyers meet sellers. And you own the numbers at the top and bottom of it. The Opportunity As Event Director, you will own one or more of our trade fair brands end to end. You will set the long-term vision, hit (and beat) the commercial targets, keep customers at the centre of everything you do, and lead a multidisciplinary team across sales, marketing, operations and content. You will be the recognised face of your shows in their industries, and the connective tissue between MMI Asia and the wider Messe München global network. This is a role with genuine ownership and the autonomy to make your mark. What You’ll Own Strategy & growth Define the 3–5 year vision and annual strategy for your portfolio, identifying where to grow – new sectors, new geographies and new formats across live, hybrid and digital. Spot and develop new opportunities, from feature zones and co-located conferences to brand extensions, geo-clones and greenfield launches across ASEAN. Use customer insight, market data and competitor intelligence to keep your shows ahead of the curve. Commercial & P&L ownership Own the full P&L for your portfolio – budgeting, forecasting, pricing and growing margin year on year. Set and steer sales targets across exhibition space, sponsorship and partnerships, working hand in hand with your sales team and commercial leaders. Report performance, risks and opportunities clearly and on time to the General Manager and leadership. Customer & market Build and protect strong relationships with key exhibitors, sponsors, associations, partners and senior industry stakeholders. Champion an outstanding experience for exhibitors and visitors – tracking satisfaction and loyalty, and acting on what you learn. Represent your brands at industry events and in the media as a credible, well-connected voice. People & leadership Build, lead, coach and inspire a high-performing, cross-functional show team. Set clear goals, give honest feedback, and create an environment where people grow and do their best work. Delivery & operations Oversee flawless end-to-end delivery of every edition – from concept and planning to onsite execution and post-show review. Partner with operations teams, venues and contractors to ensure safe, high-quality, well-run events. Direct the marketing and product development plans that drive visitor and exhibitor numbers. Network & collaboration Work within a matrix structure, coordinating with teams and departments across the global Messe München network. Share and adopt best practice in data, marketing and commercial infrastructure across the portfolio. What You’ll Bring 10+ years of commercial track record, P&L responsibility and growth obsession – not necessarily in exhibition or B2B events industry 5+ years leading and developing multinational, cross-functional teams. ASEAN launch and growth experience mixed with comfort working across cultures and time zones. An analytical, detail-minded approach and the ability to juggle multiple priorities under tight deadlines. Excellent written and spoken English; additional ASEAN languages are a plus. Willingness to travel across the region and to work flexibly around event peaks. Why Join Us You want to make money (who are we kidding?) – attractive pay and entrepreneurial incentive Real ownership – a portfolio to call your own and the autonomy to shape it. Global backing – the resources, brands and network of Messe München behind you. Real impact – the chance to build market-leading platforms that move entire industries forward. A great team – diverse, international and entrepreneurial, based in the heart of ASEAN. About MMI Asia MMI Asia is the Singapore-based subsidiary of Messe München – one of the world’s largest and most respected exhibition organisers. Yes, we are home to the F.C. Bayern Munich, Oktoberfest (we call it Wiesn), pretzels, and Adele’s spectacular summer concerts. We’re now in an ambitious growth phase in the region, through new launches, geo-clones, partnerships, joint ventures, and acquisitions. We hire ambitious, people-first professionals and give them the brands, the backing, and the room to do the best work of their careers.

review_candidates.description: Europe Hungary LE_0146-Grohe Hungary Kft Limited Contract Fully remote possible Full Time 1 November 2026 Für ein zwölfmonatiges Proof-of-Concept-Projekt zur Evaluierung einer neuen Workforce-Zeitwirtschaft suchen wir eine erfahrene Fachkraft für fachliche Systemtests (User Acceptance Testing – UAT). Im Fokus steht die fachliche Validierung einer Workforce-Lösung in einer komplexen industriellen Produktionsumgebung mit mehreren Standorten und über 3.000 Mitarbeitenden sowie unterschiedlichen Arbeitszeit- und Vergütungsmodellen. Sie prüfen die Systemlogik der Zeitwirtschaft, analysieren Prozessabweichungen und stellen die stabile Integration in nachgelagerte Payroll-Prozesse sicher. Damit leisten Sie einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Qualität und Weiterentwicklung der zukünftigen Zeitwirtschaftsprozesse. Ihre Aufgaben Erstellung fachlicher Testkonzepte, Testfälle und Testszenarien für Zeitwirtschafts- und Payroll-Prozesse Ableitung und Validierung von Testszenarien auf Basis bestehender SAP-HCM-Prozesse Abbildung und Prüfung komplexer Tarif- und Betriebsvereinbarungen (z. B. Akkordlohn, Schichtmodelle, Zuschlagslogiken) Durchführung strukturierter End-to-End-Tests (UAT) in der Workforce-Testumgebung Validierung von Zeitmodellen, Zeitbuchungen, Schichtplanung, Zuschlagsberechnungen, Abwesenheiten sowie Mehrarbeit und Überstunden Prüfung von Sonderfällen wie Kurzarbeit, Schichtwechseln und tariflichen Ausnahmeregelungen Sicherstellung der korrekten Integration zwischen Zeitwirtschaft und Payroll sowie Analyse relevanter Datenflüsse und Schnittstellen Bewertung möglicher Auswirkungen auf Entgeltabrechnung und Abrechnungssicherheit Identifikation, Analyse und strukturierte Dokumentation von Systemabweichungen, Bugs und funktionalen Einschränkungen Erstellung aussagekräftiger Testberichte sowie Bewertung der operativen Tragfähigkeit der Lösung Analyse potenzieller Risiken für Zeitwirtschafts- und Payroll-Prozesse sowie Erstellung von Entscheidungsgrundlagen für die weitere Systemstrategie Ihr Profil Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Zeitwirtschaft, Payroll, SAP HCM oder Workforce Management Fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der fachlichen Durchführung von System- und Funktionstests (UAT) Sehr gute Kenntnisse in SAP HCM sowie Erfahrung mit Workforce- bzw. Zeitwirtschaftssystemen Verständnis komplexer Zeitwirtschafts-, Tarif- und Payroll-Prozesse in einem industriellen Umfeld Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie hohe Zahlenaffinität und Genauigkeit Strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise Kommunikationsstärke sowie die Fähigkeit, fachliche Sachverhalte verständlich aufzubereiten und mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern abzustimmen Teamfähigkeit und professionelles Auftreten in einem interdisziplinären Projektumfeld Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Warum Sie Bei Uns Richtig Sind Sie gestalten die Qualität einer modernen Workforce-Zeitwirtschaft in einem komplexen Produktionsumfeld mit über 3.000 Mitarbeitenden aktiv mit und sorgen dafür, dass Zeitwirtschafts- und Payroll-Prozesse zuverlässig zusammenlaufen. Wenn Sie analytisch stark sind, strukturiert arbeiten und Freude daran haben, komplexe Prozesse greifbar und belastbar zu machen, erwartet Sie ein spannendes Projekt mit echtem Impact auf die zukünftige Systemlandschaft.

N Position Type Management Job Summary Responsible for bar/lounge daily shift operations and supervision of staff. Position assists with promoting the lounge, menu planning, maintains standards, assists servers on the floor during peak periods and manages property liquor inventories and controls. Strives to ensure guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget. Accountable for enforcing all legal obligations professionally and consistently. Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan. Strengthens the food and beverage/culinary team by assisting in other outlets when needed. CANDIDATE PROFILE Education And Experience High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES Managing Bar/Lounge Operations Implements agreed upon beverage policy and procedures throughout the property. Manages in compliance with all local, state and Federal beverage and liquor laws. Understands beverage control including days on hand, perpetual inventory, bar pars, portion control, costs controls, beverage potentials, mix of sales analysis for beverage, issue & returns, food standards, and period end inventory. Monitors adherence to all liquor control policies and procedures. Attends pre- and post-convention meetings as needed to understand group needs Comprehends budgets, operating statements and payroll progress reports as needed to assist in the financial management of department. Participates in the management of department's controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals. Manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals. Ensures compliance with all Bar/Lounge policies, standards and procedures. Maintains food handling and sanitation standards. Manages inventories according to budget and business levels. Assists with developing menus and promotions as necessary. Leading Bar/Lounge Team Trains staff on liquor control policies and procedures. Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met. Ensures employees understand expectations and parameters. Communicates critical information to the Bar/Lounge staff regarding each event. Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service Provides excellent customer service. Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels. Responds effectively to guest problems and complaints. Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service. Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement. Provides feedback to individuals in an effort to improve service performance. Reviews comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees. Managing Human Resource Activities Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job. Participates in the development and implementation of corrective action plans. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law. At more than 100 award-winning properties worldwide, The Ritz-Carlton Ladies and Gentlemen create experiences so exceptional that long after a guest stays with us, the experience stays with them. Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate. Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests. Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. And our promise to you is that we offer the chance to be proud of the work you do and who you work with. In joining The Ritz-Carlton, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.
